papers.title: Fatigue Crack Initiation and Growth Behaviour of 316L Stainless Steel Manufactured Through Selective Laser Melting
papers.abstract: Selective Laser Melting (SLM) is a relatively new manufacturing technique that offers many benefits. However the utilisation of SLM manufactured components depends on the assurance of their integrity during operation. Tensile and high cycle fatigue tests have been performed on uniaxial samples manufactured using SLM of 316L stainless steel to examine the elastic-plastic deformation and fatigue crack initiation behaviour of the material. In addition, the fatigue crack growth behaviour has been determined from tests on compact tension samples manufactured using SLM. The influence of build orientation has been examined on the compact tension samples. The results are compared to values obtained from conventional manufacturing methods. The tensile samples have a higher strength but significantly lower ductility than wrought material. The fatigue strength of the SLM material was substantially less than wrought material, though a similar fatigue limit maybe seen, this may be attributed to porosity in the material. The fatigue crack growth rate of the SLM material was 5–10 times faster, for a given stress intensity factor, than wrought materials and strongly depended on crack orientation in relation to the build direction.

llm.relevance_to_user: 这篇论文研究了SLM制造316L不锈钢的疲劳行为，但未涉及生物医学植入物、多孔结构或应力遮挡。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no porous structure, no stress shielding or stiffness matching analysis, and no surface morphology or osseointegration data.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM制造的316L不锈钢的疲劳性能，评估其完整性。
summary_zh.method: 对SLM制造的试样进行拉伸和高周疲劳测试，以及紧凑拉伸试样裂纹扩展测试。
summary_zh.result: SLM材料强度高但延展性低，疲劳强度低于锻造材料，裂纹扩展速率快5-10倍。
summary_zh.validation: 与锻造材料的力学性能对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Investigate the elastic-plastic deformation and fatigue crack initiation behavior of 316L stainless steel manufactured by selective laser melting (SLM) to assess its structural integrity.
summary_en.method: Uniaxial tensile and high-cycle fatigue tests on SLM 316L samples, plus fatigue crack growth tests on compact tension specimens, with build orientation effects examined.
summary_en.result: SLM material exhibits higher strength but lower ductility than wrought, fatigue strength significantly lower but similar endurance limit, and crack growth rate 5–10 times faster with strong orientation dependence.
summary_en.validation: Results compared with conventionally manufactured wrought material properties.

papers.title: Deformation and Fracture Behaviour of 316L Stainless Steel Manufactured Through Selective Laser Melting
papers.abstract: Selective Laser Melting (SLM) is a relatively new manufacturing technique that offers many benefits. However the utilisation of SLM manufactured components depends on the assurance of their integrity during operation. The influence of processing parameters and build orientation on the tensile deformation and Charpy impact energy has been examined. In addition, the influence of processing parameters on the resultant microstructure has been determined. The processing parameters have been found to have a significant effect on both the tensile and Charpy impact energies. It was found that a layer thickness of 25 μm, scan speed of 800 mm s−1 and hatch spacing of 60 μm resulted in the best properties determined, with tensile properties comparable to that of cold drawn material but impact energies around 25% lower. Significant porosity was observed in the samples especially for high scan speeds and hatch spacing which is considered to be the main cause of poor material properties in most samples examined.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注SLM工艺参数对316L不锈钢力学性能的影响，但未涉及生物医学植入物所需的应力遮挡、疲劳性能或多孔结构设计。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, surface roughness, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究SLM工艺参数对316L不锈钢力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过拉伸和夏比冲击试验，结合显微组织表征，分析不同工艺参数下的性能。
summary_zh.result: 最佳参数下拉伸性能媲美冷拉材料，但冲击韧性低25%，孔隙是主要缺陷。
summary_zh.validation: 拉伸与冲击试验验证力学性能，显微组织观察解释机理。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of selective laser melting processing parameters and build orientation on the mechanical properties of 316L stainless steel.
summary_en.method: Tensile tests and Charpy impact tests were performed on specimens fabricated with varying layer thickness, scan speed, and hatch spacing; microstructures were characterized.
summary_en.result: Optimal parameters (25 μm layer thickness, 800 mm/s scan speed, 60 μm hatch spacing) yielded tensile properties comparable to cold-drawn material but impact energy 25% lower; porosity was the primary cause of degraded properties.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (tensile and Charpy impact) along with microstructural analysis validated the findings.

papers.title: Characterization of Additively Manufactured Heat Exchanger Tubing
papers.abstract: Additive Manufacturing brings unique opportunities to the fabrication world, especially for complex, high value added components that are challenging if not impossible to fabricate using traditional technologies. There are several different technologies that can be used for making metal additive manufactured parts. In this study, selective laser melting (SLM) was used to fabricate conceptual process tubing. Through an evolutionary design and build process coupled with thermal and mechanical modeling, tubing with a unique additive manufacturing compatible geometry has been fabricated. This paper will briefly describe the application, which has a thermal swing from nominally 140°C to −40°C, the evolution of the design, and the characterization conducted to date. Finally, the challenges of designing and printing a coiled segment of this tubing that is 150 cm long will be described. The results will include non-destructive and destructive testing and evaluation. The data from tensile testing the first and second generations of the tubing will be compared. The properties and characterization of the surrogate coil will be described and discussed. Future component development and testing will be discussed for this unique AM process tubing.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及热交换器管道的增材制造与力学测试，与生物医学植入物的应力遮挡、多孔结构或骨整合无关联。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical application, no porous structure, no stress shielding or stiffness matching, no fatigue testing, no osseointegration or surface morphology analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索增材制造技术在复杂热交换器管道中的应用与挑战。
summary_zh.method: 采用选择性激光熔融技术，结合热力学与力学建模，设计并制造独特几何形状的管道。
summary_zh.result: 完成了两代管道的拉伸测试及无损检测，验证了制造工艺的可行性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸测试和无损/有损检测评估管道力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the application of additive manufacturing for complex heat exchanger tubing, leveraging design freedom and thermal-mechanical modeling.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting (SLM) was employed to fabricate tubing with an additive-manufacturing-compatible geometry, guided by iterative design and thermal/mechanical simulations.
summary_en.result: Tensile testing and non-destructive evaluation of first- and second-generation tubing were conducted, showing improved properties and characterizing a surrogate coil.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical validation via tensile testing and combined non-destructive/destructive evaluation.
